nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space. Every series of functions $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) with values in a seminormed additive commutative group $E$ converges locally normally on the empty set.
nodes.title: Local normal convergence on the empty set

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space and $E$ a seminormed additive commutative group. For every set $S \subseteq X$, the series of functions $X \to E$ whose terms are all zero converges locally normally on $S$.
nodes.title: Local normal convergence of the zero series

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space and $E$ a seminormed additive commutative group. A series of functions $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) converges locally normally on a set $S \subseteq X$ when every $x \in S$ has a neighbourhood $U$ such that the series converges normally on $U \cap S$.
nodes.title: Local normal convergence of a series of functions on a set

nodes.summary: Every series of functions $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) with values in a seminormed additive commutative group $E$ converges normally on the empty set.
nodes.title: Normal convergence on the empty set

nodes.summary: For every set $S \subseteq X$ and every seminormed additive commutative group $E$, the series of functions $X \to E$ whose terms are all zero converges normally on $S$.
nodes.title: Normal convergence of the zero series

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a type and $E$ a seminormed additive commutative group. A series of functions $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) converges normally on a set $S \subseteq X$ when the sum $\sum_{n} \sup_{x \in S} \|f_n(x)\|$ is finite, where each supremum norm and the sum are taken in the extended nonnegative reals $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Normal convergence of a series of functions on a set

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{C}$, $S \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ an open set and $f_n \colon \mathbb{C} \to E$ for $n \in \mathbb{N}$ functions that are complex differentiable on $S$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges locally normally on $S$, that is every $z \in S$ has a neighbourhood $U$ with $\sum_n \sup_{w \in U \cap S} \|f_n(w)\| < \infty$ (suprema taken in $[0, \infty]$), then the series of…
nodes.title: Derivative series of a locally normally convergent holomorphic series

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space, $E$ a seminormed additive commutative group, $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) functions and $S \subseteq X$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges locally normally on $S$, then every $x \in S$ has a neighbourhood $U$ such that the series converges normally on $U \cap S$.
nodes.title: Local normal convergence gives a neighbourhood of each point of the set

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complete normed space over $\mathbb{C}$, $S \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ an open set and $f_n \colon \mathbb{C} \to E$ for $n \in \mathbb{N}$ functions that are complex differentiable on $S$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges locally normally on $S$, that is every $z \in S$ has a neighbourhood $U$ with $\sum_n \sup_{w \in U \cap S} \|f_n(w)\| < \infty$ (suprema taken in $[0, \infty]$), then for every…
nodes.title: Termwise differentiation of locally normally convergent holomorphic series

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a topological space, let $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) be functions into a seminormed additive commutative group $E$ and let $T \subseteq S \subseteq X$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges locally normally on $S$, then it converges locally normally on $T$.
nodes.title: Local normal convergence passes to subsets

nodes.summary: Let $f_n \colon X \to E$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) be functions into a seminormed additive commutative group $E$ and let $T \subseteq S \subseteq X$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges normally on $S$, then it converges normally on $T$.
nodes.title: Normal convergence passes to subsets

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a seminormed additive commutative group, $S$ a subset of a topological space $X$ and $f_n \colon X \to E$ for $n \in \mathbb{N}$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges locally normally on $S$, that is every $x \in S$ has a neighbourhood $U$ with $\sum_n \sup_{y \in U \cap S} \|f_n(y)\| < \infty$ (suprema taken in $[0, \infty]$), then for every $x \in S$ the series $\sum_n \|f_n(x)\|$ is summable.
nodes.title: Local normal convergence implies pointwise absolute convergence

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a seminormed additive commutative group, $S$ a subset of a type $X$ and $f_n \colon X \to E$ for $n \in \mathbb{N}$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges normally on $S$, that is $\sum_n \sup_{x \in S} \|f_n(x)\| < \infty$ with the suprema taken in $[0, \infty]$, then for every $x \in S$ the series $\sum_n \|f_n(x)\|$ is summable.
nodes.title: Normal convergence implies pointwise absolute convergence

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a seminormed additive commutative group, $S$ a subset of a type $X$ and $f_n \colon X \to E$ for $n \in \mathbb{N}$. If the series $\sum_n f_n$ converges normally on $S$, that is $\sum_n \sup_{x \in S} \|f_n(x)\| < \infty$ with the suprema taken in $[0, \infty]$, then the sequence of sup norms $\left(\sup_{x \in S} \|f_n(x)\|\right)_n$, viewed as real numbers, is summable.
nodes.title: Normal convergence gives summable real sup norms

nodes.summary: For every function $g \colon X \to E$ into a seminormed additive commutative group $E$, the supremum norm of $g$ on the empty set, valued in $[0, \infty]$, is $0$.
nodes.title: Supremum norm over the empty set

nodes.summary: If $T \subseteq S \subseteq X$, then for every function $g \colon X \to E$ into a seminormed additive commutative group $E$, the supremum norm of $g$ on $T$ is at most the supremum norm of $g$ on $S$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the supremum norm in the domain

nodes.summary: For every set $S \subseteq X$, the supremum norm on $S$ of the zero function from $X$ to a seminormed additive commutative group $E$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Supremum norm of the zero function

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a type and $E$ a seminormed additive commutative group. For a function $g : X \to E$ and a set $S \subseteq X$, the supremum norm of $g$ on $S$ is $\sup_{x \in S} \|g(x)\|$, taken in the extended nonnegative reals $[0, \infty]$; in particular it is $0$ when $S$ is empty and $\infty$ when $\|g\|$ is unbounded on $S$.
nodes.title: Extended supremum norm on a set

nodes.title: Local normal convergence implies locally uniform convergence

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a complete normed additive commutative group, $S$ a subset of a type $X$ and $f_n \colon X \to E$ for $n \in \mathbb{N}$. nodes.title: Weierstrass M-test: normal convergence implies uniform convergence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
